name: manual_5d4544
claim: Program-level rows whose names carry a phase prefix and a tasklist pointer are coordination reminders, not implementation lanes. Reconcile them closed against their verified implementation lane with evidence; never claim them for implementation, because the program invariant that created them exists precisely to stop two agents doing the same work under two different ids.

decisions.notes: Seven MigrationProgram rows sat QUEUED after the migration waves closed, but the program tasklist stated outright that they are superseded pointers while the authoritative mig-* implementation lanes own the work. All six with verified lanes were closed as superseded with per-row evidence, and the seventh was left queued as operator-only. Claiming them as implementation would have duplicated six finished workstreams and contradicted the program ledger.
